lines.t: YahuShua, The Messiah, is The Only Way
If you thought His name was Jesus, know that it's OK.
There is no man - who ever can - change who He is
The God of Mercy and Great Love and full of righteousness
You should know, that every other road, is the way to death
So be aware, that you don't go there, don't even second guess
In YahuShua alone - you find your Home - and The Life you want to live
It doesn't matter who you are - or how far - He will forgive
By His blood this grace was bought and it can't be earned!
Even still - it's our freewill - to receive of it and turn
There is no doubt - He's been calling out - to you continually
It is because - You have been loved - from all eternity
If you turn about - to seek Him out - you will surely come to know
Eternal life, the good life, He has always longed to show
If you will seek Him in truth and in all sincerity
For it is He - The God who sees - our heart and what it speaks
So look within - open up to Him - you don't need to hide
If you'll be wise - don't close your eyes - He already knows what's inside
He knows you, He loves you, and He's been waiting for you
So let Him in - turn from sin - and learn to love what is True
If that seems hard - or seems so far - do not be afraid
Your not by yourself - He will be your help - and show you The Way
Even at our best - He knows that in our flesh - life can be hard
Still He drank the cup - gave His body up - to be tortured and marred
He was God and man - who could've ran - and chose to put His Love on open display!
In all the pain - and the suffering - His heart rejoiced on that day!
He knew you then, who you will be, and He knows you now
He knew the day, you would pray, and finally call out
It was the same day, your heart began to say, that all of this sin
Is not the way, the truth or life, I want to be living in
So then come and taste and see that The Lord is so good!
Then your mind - will want to leave behind - those things which were nailed to wood
Don't look back nor from side to side
Let nothing in all the world keep Him from your eyes
Love Him more than anyone or anything
Let Him rule - inside your heart - For He is your King
If you will believe - if you will receive - you will surely come to know
The Prince of Peace, and you will feast, and your cup will overflow
